description: This is a PostgreSQL schema definition file for the Nutrition Connect Platform. It defines database tables, indexes, extensions, functions, and triggers for managing users, profiles, foods, recipes, exercises, workouts, habits, plans, logs, conversations, billing, analytics, files, tags, and associated relationships.

methods.name: set_updated_at
methods.description: A function that automatically updates the 'updated_at' timestamp before any row in certain tables is updated.
